  (width : Std.Usize) (n : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array aspis_core.field.M31 256#usize)
  := do
  if n >= width
  then ok basis
  else
    let basis1 ← basis_block_owned basis node n 0#usize
    let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul node node

    let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.ONE
    let node1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m1 m2
    let i ← n * 2#usize
    basis_levels_owned basis1 node1 width i
